channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period's clearest wins are concrete private investment: Burger King's $2.5M reopening after a decade off the island, Walmart's $20M Mayagüez land buy, Dunkin's return via a new Fusion Restaurant Group/Inspire Brands agreement, and DDEC's reshoring push citing roughly 25 projects worth over $2 billion and a $46M Taiwanese biopharmaceutical facility, reinforced by the Governor's investor pitch trip to New York. Real risks persist alongside the good news: chronic drought-driven water rationing and a looming AAA/UIA strike vote, a $5.9 billion Power Expectations power-contract scandal tied to fraud allegations, and sustained community opposition (including a Cabo Rojo march) to the $2 billion Esencia tourism megaproject. Municipal fiscal fragility (43% of municipalities running deficits) and ongoing Hilton Garden Inn Dorado litigation add further site-selection risk signals.
